item.title: Interior Dept. moves forward on Colorado River guidelines without full state consensus
item.description: The Dept. of the Interior has decided to move forward with the Post-2026 NEPA process, establishing new operating guidelines for the Colorado River reservoirs by Oct. 1, 2026, despite not having reached an agreement between the seven Basin States.

item.title: Patti Edwards, widow of legendary BYU football coach LaVell Edwards, dies at 93
item.description: Patti Louise Covey Edwards, widow of legendary BYU football coach and hall-of-famer LaVell Edwards, passed away on February 13, 2026. She was 93.
